name: issued-value-as-plain-digits
violates: spec §2.3: a JSON leaf is the JSON its own bytes decode to; an issued amount's value has one text
notes: Found by Neon's differential run at code 19a04df5 (reviews/xprv-v10-code-claude/neon-fuzz-19a04df5.md). 10^30 written as 31 plain digits, which is the text xrpl-py decodes these bytes to. The Python verifier accepted it and the C++ one could not read it.

expect.reason_contains: not the JSON its bytes decode to
